meaning:
1) what is gathered, store, storing, storehouse
2) (CLBL) threshold (metonomy)

renderings.bsb: and the lot for the storehouses

elsewhere.note: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.
